lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition K28Ca4 (reduced formula K7Ca) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Ca and K centers in 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Ca surrounded by 12 K neighbors and K by mixed Ca/K neighbors, and neighbor distances ranging from 3.59 to 3.68 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals 12-vertex K coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, though these relations are not exclusive for all polyhedra.
